
== Japanese printing source audit ==
Added the original Japanese face from encyclopedia p. 43 (xref 2059, image SHA256 <code style="white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere">3bb874a45a9d255f7abce73a279a4c1182b88bf985b5c912c7a38235414d6bed</code>). <ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> The full original is [[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Admiral-Ozzel-Encyclopedia32-original.jpg]]. Printed wraps are joined and numeric/Latin glyphs normalized; underlined lore characteristics are retained. Counted the complete title and symbol groups. The English reading aid is tied to this source transcription. The Japanese lore expresses the English “next-to-last time” joke as allowing no further failures. Its final game-text condition explicitly says that the opponent moves to Ozzel's location as a react (リアクションで移動してきた), where the original English says only that the opponent “‘reacts’ to same location as Ozzel.” Both original faces restrict his +2 pilot bonus to a starship. Printed absence, rule-derived defaults and comparison-only English engine code are distinguished in the field audit. No Japanese GEMP implementation or new gameplay ruling is claimed. The explicit movement-react wording remains a wording difference with historical-rules applicability recorded separately. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 7 November 2026 (UTC)
